properties.entry: SELECT A.BOARD_NO, A.BOARD_TYPE, CASE WHEN A.BOARD_TYPE = 1 THEN '일반' ELSE '사진' END BOARD_TYPE_NAME, A.CATEGORY_NO, B.CATEGORY_NAME, A.BOARD_TITLE, A.BOARD_CONTENT, A.BOARD_WRITER, C.MEMBER_NAME, A.COUNT, A.CREATE_DATE, A.STATUS FROM BOARD A JOIN CATEGORY B ON A.CATEGORY_NO = B.CATEGORY_NO JOIN MEMBER C ON A.BOARD_WRITER = C.MEMBER_NO WHERE A.STATUS = 'Y' AND A.BOARD_TYPE = ? ORDER BY A.BOARD_NO DESC OFFSET (?-1)*5 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM BOARD WHERE STATUS = 'Y' AND BOARD_TYPE = ?
INSERT INTO BOARD( BOARD_NO, BOARD_TYPE, CATEGORY_NO, BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_CONTENT, BOARD_WRITER, COUNT, CREATE_DATE, STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_BNO.NEXTVAL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, SYSDATE, 'Y' )
INSERT INTO ATTACHMENT ( FILE_NO, REF_BNO, ORIGIN_NAME, CHANGE_NAME, FILE_PATH, UPLOAD_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_FNO.NEXTVAL, SEQ_BNO.CURRVAL, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE )

SELECT A.BOARD_NO, A.BOARD_TYPE, CASE WHEN A.BOARD_TYPE = 1 THEN '일반' ELSE '사진' END BOARD_TYPE_NAME, A.CATEGORY_NO, B.CATEGORY_NAME, A.BOARD_TITLE, A.BOARD_CONTENT, A.BOARD_WRITER, C.MEMBER_NAME, A.COUNT, A.CREATE_DATE, A.STATUS FROM BOARD A JOIN CATEGORY B ON A.CATEGORY_NO = B.CATEGORY_NO JOIN MEMBER C ON A.BOARD_WRITER = C.MEMBER_NO WHERE A.BOARD_NO = ?
UPDATE BOARD SET COUNT = COUNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_NO = ?
UPDATE BOARD SET CATEGORY_NO = ?, BOARD_TITLE = ?, BOARD_CONTENT = ? WHERE BOARD_NO = ?
UPDATE BOARD SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE BOARD_NO = ?
INSERT INTO REPLY ( REPLY_NO, REPLY_CONTENT, REF_BNO, REPLY_WRITER, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_RNO.NEXTVAL, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE )

SELECT REPLY_NO, REPLY_CONTENT, MEMBER_ID, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI') AS CREATE_DATE FROM REPLY R JOIN MEMBER M ON(REPLY_WRITER = MEMBER_NO) WHERE REF_BNO = ? AND R.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY REPLY_NO DESC
UPDATE REPLY SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE REPLY_NO = ?
